import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyMayerVietoris
import MumfordLib.SingularCochainMayerVietoris

/-!
# The ordinary singular Mayer--Vietoris consumer

For a two-set open cover, the small-singular comparison transports the cochain
Mayer--Vietoris sequence to ordinary integral singular cohomology. The resulting
connecting morphism is exact at the intersection and at positive-degree ambient
cohomology; restriction is injective in degree zero. The overlap comparison uses
the canonical equality `singularSubset_inter`.

This is infrastructure for the product calculation in Mumford, Chapter I,
Section 1, integral cohomology. The cup-compatible product calculation is separate.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X)

def singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n ≅
      (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex (singularSubset X U)
        (singularSubset X V)).map
        (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n) := by
  let e₁ : (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n).X₁ ≅
      ((simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex (singularSubset X U)
        (singularSubset X V)).map
        (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).X₁ :=
    singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover n
  let e₂ : (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n).X₂ ≅
      ((simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex (singularSubset X U)
        (singularSubset X V)).map
        (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).X₂ :=
    (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).symm
  let M : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex :=
    (singularSubset X U : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex) ⊓
      (singularSubset X V : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex)
  let e₃ : (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n).X₃ ≅
      ((simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex (singularSubset X U)
        (singularSubset X V)).map
        (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).X₃ := by
    change IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) n ≅
      IntegralSimplicialCohomology M.toSSet n
    dsimp [M]
    exact (singularSubsetCohomologyIso X (U ∩ V) n).symm ≪≫
      (simplicialCohomologyIso
        (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)) n).symm
  refine ShortComplex.isoMk e₁ e₂ e₃ ?_ ?_
  · apply (cancel_mono (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).hom).mp
    change homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
        (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V).ι) n ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction
        (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V)) n ≫
        (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).hom =
      (singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V n ≫
        (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).inv) ≫
        (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).hom
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    exact singularPairCohomologyIso_restriction X U V n
  · change (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).inv ≫
        homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference
          (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V)) n =
      singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference X U V n ≫
        ((singularSubsetCohomologyIso X (U ∩ V : Set X) n).symm ≪≫
          (simplicialCohomologyIso
            (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)) n).symm).hom
    apply biprod.hom_ext'
    swap
    · simp only [singularPairCohomologyIso, integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso,
        Iso.trans_inv, biprod.mapIso_inv,
        integralSimplicialCohomologyIntersectionDifference_eq_pair, ← homologyMap_comp,
        Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.assoc, biprod.inr_map_assoc, biprod.inr_desc_assoc,
        integralSimplicialCochainPairInr_fst_assoc, zero_comp, homologyMap_zero, comp_zero,
        integralSimplicialCochainPairInr_snd_assoc, zero_sub, singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference,
        Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Preadditive.neg_comp, neg_inj]
      change homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
          (singularSubsetIso X V).inv) n ≫
          homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
            (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right)) n =
        homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
          (TopCat.toSSet.map
            (singularSubsetMap X (Set.inter_subset_right : U ∩ V ⊆ V)))) n ≫
          homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
            (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) n ≫
          homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
            (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv) n
      rw [integralSimplicialCochainPullback_toSSet]
      rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← homologyMap_comp, ← homologyMap_comp]
      congr 1
      rw [← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp,
        ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]
      change integralSimplicialCochainPullback
          (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right ≫ (singularSubsetIso X V).inv) =
        integralSimplicialCochainPullback
          (TopCat.toSSet.map
            (singularSubsetMap X (Set.inter_subset_right : U ∩ V ⊆ V))) ≫
          integralSimplicialCochainPullback
            ((SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
              (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv)
      rw [← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]
      congr 1
      apply (cancel_mono (singularSubsetIso X V).hom).mp
      rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [← singularSubsetIso_naturality X
        (Set.inter_subset_right : U ∩ V ⊆ V)]
      simp
      rfl
    · simp only [singularPairCohomologyIso, integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso,
        Iso.trans_inv, biprod.mapIso_inv,
        integralSimplicialCohomologyIntersectionDifference_eq_pair, ← homologyMap_comp,
        Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.assoc, biprod.inl_map_assoc, biprod.inl_desc_assoc,
        integralSimplicialCochainPairInl_fst_assoc,
        integralSimplicialCochainPairInl_snd_assoc, zero_comp,
        homologyMap_zero, comp_zero, sub_zero, singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference, Iso.trans_hom,
        Iso.symm_hom]
      change homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
          (singularSubsetIso X U).inv) n ≫
          homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
            (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left)) n =
        homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
          (TopCat.toSSet.map
            (singularSubsetMap X (Set.inter_subset_left : U ∩ V ⊆ U)))) n ≫
          homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
            (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) n ≫
          homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
            (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv) n
      rw [integralSimplicialCochainPullback_toSSet]
      rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← homologyMap_comp, ← homologyMap_comp]
      congr 1
      rw [← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp,
        ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]
      change integralSimplicialCochainPullback
          (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left ≫ (singularSubsetIso X U).inv) =
        integralSimplicialCochainPullback
          (TopCat.toSSet.map
            (singularSubsetMap X (Set.inter_subset_left : U ∩ V ⊆ U))) ≫
          integralSimplicialCochainPullback
            ((SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
              (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv)
      rw [← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]
      congr 1
      apply (cancel_mono (singularSubsetIso X U).hom).mp
      rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [← singularSubsetIso_naturality X
        (Set.inter_subset_left : U ∩ V ⊆ U)]
      simp
      rfl

@[simp]
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso_hom_τ₁
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom.τ₁ =
      (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom := rfl

@[simp]
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso_hom_τ₂
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom.τ₂ =
      (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).inv := rfl

@[simp]
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso_hom_τ₃
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom.τ₃ =
      ((singularSubsetCohomologyIso X (U ∩ V) n).symm ≪≫
        (simplicialCohomologyIso
          (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)) n).symm).hom := rfl

@[simp]
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso_inv_τ₁
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).inv.τ₁ =
      (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover n).inv := rfl

@[simp]
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso_inv_τ₂
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).inv.τ₂ =
      (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).hom := rfl

@[simp]
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso_inv_τ₃
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).inv.τ₃ =
      ((singularSubsetCohomologyIso X (U ∩ V) n).symm ≪≫
        (simplicialCohomologyIso
          (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)) n).symm).inv := rfl

theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_consumer
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n).Exact := by
  exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso
      (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n)).mpr
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_pair
      (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n)

variable (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ)

include hU hV hcover in
/-- The initial restriction map in the singular Mayer--Vietoris sequence is
injective: there are no incoming coboundaries in degree zero. -/
theorem singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction_mono_zero :
    Mono (singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V 0) := by
  let A := singularSubset X U
  let B := singularSubset X V
  letI : Mono ((integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B).f 0) :=
    (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisDegree_shortExact A B 0).mono_f
  have hmono : Mono (homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) 0) :=
    mono_homologyMap_of_mono_of_not_rel _ 0 (by simp [ComplexShape.up_Rel])
  let e := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover 0
  exact ((MorphismProperty.monomorphisms (ModuleCat ℤ)).arrow_mk_iso_iff
    (Arrow.isoMk (ShortComplex.π₁.mapIso e) (ShortComplex.π₂.mapIso e)
      e.hom.comm₁₂)).mpr hmono

/-- The connecting morphism for an open cover, transported from the short exact
sequence of cochains on the small singular subcomplex. -/
def singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) n ⟶
      IntegralSingularCohomology X (n + 1) :=
  (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom.τ₃ ≫
    simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n ≫
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)).inv.τ₁

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_restriction (n : ℕ) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover n ≫
      singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V (n + 1) = 0 := by
  let e := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n
  let e' := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)
  change (e.hom.τ₃ ≫
    simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n ≫
    e'.inv.τ₁) ≫ (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V (n + 1)).f = 0
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [e'.inv.comm₁₂]
  simp only [ShortComplex.map_f, homologyFunctor_map, Preadditive.IsIso.comp_left_eq_zero]
  exact (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_restriction_assoc
    (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n e'.inv.τ₂).trans zero_comp

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisDifference_connecting (n : ℕ) :
    singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference X U V n ≫
      singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover n = 0 := by
  let e := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n
  let e' := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)
  change (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n).g ≫ e.hom.τ₃ ≫
    simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n ≫
    e'.inv.τ₁ = 0
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← e.hom.comm₂₃, Category.assoc]
  simp only [ShortComplex.map_g, homologyFunctor_map, Preadditive.IsIso.comp_left_eq_zero]
  exact (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisDifference_connecting_assoc
    (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n e'.inv.τ₁).trans zero_comp

/-- Exactness of the ordinary singular Mayer--Vietoris sequence at the
cohomology of the intersection. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_intersection (n : ℕ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk _ _
      (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisDifference_connecting X U V hU hV hcover n)).Exact := by
  let e := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n
  let e' := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)
  let d := simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting
    (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n
  apply (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso (ShortComplex.isoMk
    (ShortComplex.π₂.mapIso e) (ShortComplex.π₃.mapIso e)
    (ShortComplex.π₁.mapIso e') ?_ ?_)).mpr
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_intersection
      (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n)
  · exact e.hom.comm₂₃
  · change e.hom.τ₃ ≫ d = (e.hom.τ₃ ≫ d ≫ e'.inv.τ₁) ≫ e'.hom.τ₁
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    erw [(ShortComplex.π₁.mapIso e').inv_hom_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
    rfl

/-- Exactness of the ordinary singular Mayer--Vietoris sequence at the
positive-degree cohomology of the ambient space. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_union (n : ℕ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk _ _
      (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_restriction X U V hU hV hcover n)).Exact := by
  let e := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n
  let e' := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)
  let d := simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting
    (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n
  apply (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso (ShortComplex.isoMk
    (ShortComplex.π₃.mapIso e) (ShortComplex.π₁.mapIso e')
    (ShortComplex.π₂.mapIso e') ?_ ?_)).mpr
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_union
      (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n)
  · change e.hom.τ₃ ≫ d = (e.hom.τ₃ ≫ d ≫ e'.inv.τ₁) ≫ e'.hom.τ₁
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    erw [(ShortComplex.π₁.mapIso e').inv_hom_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  · exact e'.hom.comm₁₂

end Mumford.Analytic
